snippet.title: v8.6 The Banquet Operative Trailer — Honkai Impact 3rd
snippet.description:
v8.6 The Banquet Operative is about to begin! Rita Rossweisse's new S-rank battlesuit "Miss Espionage" debuts!
Stay tuned for Main Story Part 2 Chapter XI: A Mass for Atheists, featured event "Agent Rosette: Banquet of Intrigue", and new outfits!
Voice Artists:
Youyun: Megu Umezawa
Rita Rossweisse: Aoi Yuki
